panel.introduction: Proteus is Neptune’s largest inner moon. Voyager 2 revealed an angular, cratered world, dominated on one side by the enormous impact basin Pharos.

controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Voyager 2 clear-filter imagery registered to the PDS Stooke shape. Measured sky-background subtraction and bounded illumination correction reduce photographed shading. Gray grid marks unavailable or unreliable samples. The distant hemisphere and cast shadows are not reconstructed.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Radial height above a 208 km reference sphere from Stooke’s Voyager-derived shape model. Shows the broad irregular shape, not local height above a geoid. The archived 5° radius grid includes modeled unseen terrain and can exaggerate facets or depressions. Small craters are not resolved.
